title: Africa
description: 《Africa》描寫一段充滿神秘、渴望與內心掙扎的旅程，結合了愛情、冒險與自我探索。歌中的主角受到非洲遼闊大地與自然景色的吸引，從遠方的鼓聲、夜裡的野獸叫聲，到壯麗的山脈，都象徵著未知與自由。他一方面渴望與心愛的人相聚，另一方面也希望透過這段旅程尋找人生的方向，治癒內心深處的不安與迷惘。歌曲中的雨水象徵祝福、希望與心靈的洗滌。最終，《Africa》傳達的是對愛情、自然與生命意義的追尋：即使面對未知與恐懼，也要勇敢聆聽內心的聲音，尋找真正屬於自己的歸宿。

vocabulary.usage: 聲音在山谷、大房間或空曠地方傳開，並再次被聽到。
options: I echo my passport because the guard needs to see it.
Dad shouted “Hello!” and heard it echo inside the cave.
She put an echo on her desk to charge her phone.
We echo to school by bus every day.
vocabulary.explanation: echo 表示聲音迴響；洞內的回音符合用法。
optionExplanations: 出示護照應用 show；echo 表示聲音迴響。
echo 表示聲音迴響；洞內的回音符合用法。
充電需要充電器；echo 指回音。
錯誤：echo 不是「搭車去」，應說 go to school。

vocabulary.usage: 在圖書館、有人睡覺時，或想小聲告訴別人事情時。
options: Please whisper because the baby is sleeping.
My brother whispered his suitcase onto the train.
She whispered her phone to make the screen brighter.
The teacher whispered very loudly so the whole school heard.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：寶寶在睡覺，所以請輕聲說話。
optionExplanations: 正確：寶寶在睡覺，所以請輕聲說話。
把行李搬上車應用 carried；whisper 指小聲說話。
調亮螢幕應用 turn up the brightness；whisper 無法表達操作手機。
錯誤：whisper 是低聲說，與 very loudly 矛盾。

vocabulary.usage: 描述從某地到另一地時，途中發生的事。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「along the way」？
options: I put ten dollars along the way in my bank account.
She is along the way tall and happy.
We found a tiny museum along the way to our hotel.
My boss was along the way of Friday.
vocabulary.explanation: along the way 表示途中；去酒店途中發現博物館。
optionExplanations: 存錢可說 put money in an account；along the way 表示途中。
錯誤：along the way 不能放在形容身高的地方。
along the way 表示途中；去酒店途中發現博物館。
along the way 描述途中，不能接 of Friday。

vocabulary.usage: 看到某人的樣子，猜測他好像正在做什麼或有某種感覺。
options: I drink as if a glass of water after school.
My bag is as if under the chair.
He walked as if to the supermarket at six.
He waves as if he knows the star. She is looking at someone else.
vocabulary.explanation: as if 引出看起來像真的情況；他以為明星在看自己。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：as if 不能代替 drink 後面的受詞。
錯誤：表示位置直接說 My bag is under the chair。
錯誤：單純說去超市不需要 as if，應說 walked to the supermarket。
as if 引出看起來像真的情況；他以為明星在看自己。

vocabulary.usage: 時間不夠、快遲到，或需要別人加快動作時。
options: I put my hurry in the lift and pressed floor three.
Hurry! The bus is leaving in one minute!
He hurried his blue shirt on the chair.
We booked a hurry for two nights in London.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：公車快開了，所以要趕快。
optionExplanations: hurry 不能當作可以放進電梯的物件。
正確：公車快開了，所以要趕快。
錯誤：hurry 不能表示把衣服放在椅子上。
訂住宿應說 booked a room；hurry 無法作房型名稱。

vocabulary.usage: 事情無法立刻完成，需要等候或慢慢做。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「take some time」？
options: Learning a new song can take some time.
I take some time into my phone and press send.
My brother takes some time his train ticket at the gate.
Please take some time the window because it is hot.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：學會一首新歌可能需要一段時間。
optionExplanations: 正確：學會一首新歌可能需要一段時間。
take some time 表示需要一段時間，不能當成可傳送的訊息。
這裡需要 checks 或 shows；take some time 後面不能直接這樣接車票。
錯誤：take some time 後面不能直接接 the window 來表示開窗。

vocabulary.usage: 因為害怕、痛苦、驚訝，或需要幫忙而大聲喊叫時。
options: I cry out my bank card to pay for the film.
She cried out a hotel room for Saturday.
The boy cried out for help when he fell.
They cried out the lights before bed.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：男孩跌倒時大聲呼救，cry out for help 用法自然。
optionExplanations: 付款用銀行卡應說 use my bank card。
預訂房間應用 booked；cried out 表示大叫。
正確：男孩跌倒時大聲呼救，cry out for help 用法自然。
錯誤：關燈應說 turned off the lights。

vocabulary.usage: 很想見到某個人、去某個地方，或得到某樣東西時。
options: After a month away, I longed for home.
He longed for his phone to make the battery full.
We long for the lift by pressing floor five.
I long for my pencil with a ruler.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：離家一個月後，非常想念家。
optionExplanations: 正確：離家一個月後，非常想念家。
long for 表示渴望；想念手機不等於替它充電。
按樓層鍵是在操作電梯；long for 無法表達這個動作。
錯誤：這裡不能用 long for 表示用尺和鉛筆做事。

vocabulary.usage: 在需要選擇時，決定做誠實、公平或對別人好的事。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「do what is right」？
options: We do what is right our bags on the floor.
I did what was right my password, so it had eight letters.
She did what is right to cook the music.
I returned the extra money. I did what was right.
vocabulary.explanation: do what is right 表示做正確、誠實的事。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：句子缺少必要的動詞連接方式，片語也用得不自然。
do what is right 後面不能直接接 my password；改密碼可用 changed。
錯誤：cook the music 不合語意，也沒有表達正確的選擇。
do what is right 表示做正確、誠實的事。

vocabulary.usage: 描述害怕某個人、動物、東西或事情。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「be frightened of」？
options: I am frightened of quickly my job interview.
Ben is frightened of lifts. He takes the stairs and calls it exercise.
I am frightened of to go the school.
He frightened of his bike yesterday.
vocabulary.explanation: be frightened of 表示害怕；Ben 用運動來解釋走樓梯。
optionExplanations: of 後面要接名詞或動名詞；quickly 放在這裡不成立。
be frightened of 表示害怕；Ben 用運動來解釋走樓梯。
錯誤：of 後不能直接接 to go；可說 frightened of going to school。
錯誤：缺少 be 動詞，應說 He was frightened of his bike。
